The three Lily guards on the new Lily (flat renders, real script, hair colour #7a5230 painted onto copies): geometry of the bangs rectangle is rows 226 to 234 and columns 440 to 584 (9 by 145 px, 1305 px; eye components x 440-485 and 539-584, tops 235 and 236), and it holds only skin and eye white, as before. The unmodified Lily gives no guard (exit 0). A bridge strip gives the bangs line at alpha 255, 251 and 250 and none at 249 and 128; colour distance 40 gives it and 41 does not on R, G and B; a pixel at row 226 and row 234 fires, rows 225 and 235 do not; columns 440 and 584 fire, 439 and 585 do not; a temple pixel 30 px outside and a fringe above the window pass; a fringe over one eye, both eyes, the upper half of both eyes or the upper third of one eye fails the eye-component rule. The chin band (rows 322 to 369) fires for hair at its top row 322 and not at row 321, and not at alpha 249; the side guard fires for hair at the frontmost chin pixel at alpha 255, 191 and 128 and for a mouth-coloured one, and not for skin at alpha 191. The real frontmost side chin pixels are skin (#f1c5a3 at alpha 128 and #f2c7a4 at alpha 191).

Chin guard against the mouth colour (Chebyshev 40 rule): the mouth is still #c04040 and 1015 px of it lie in the chin band; the nearest chin-band colour to the hair #7a5230 is 58 away (a freckle-range #b4703d), and the nearest mouth-skin blend is 70.5 away, so the margin is 18 and 30 px beyond the 40 radius. A dark mouth (skin-to-#6a3028, #5a2a2a, #8a3a30 blends within 11, 15 and 20) would cross it, which is the spec rule 6 reason, and the real mouth does not.

Adults and Mom: fresh runs of the HEAD script on the real Dad, Grandma, Grandpa and Mom outputs reproduce their real records exactly (asset, base, hashes, rows, detail, guards, palms, ppm, faceMarks, handEdge, sideSign), both palms ok, no guard.
